final: WITH city_counts AS (SELECT city_id, COUNT(*) AS address_count FROM address GROUP BY city_id), average_count AS (SELECT AVG(address_count) AS avg_count FROM city_counts), with_average AS (SELECT c.city_id, c.address_count, c.address_count / a.avg_count AS share_of_average FROM city_counts AS c CROSS JOIN average_count AS a WHERE a.avg_count IS NOT NULL), total_count AS (SELECT SUM(address_count) AS total FROM with_average) SELECT w.city_id, w.address_count, w.share_of_average, 1.0 * w.address_count / t.total AS share_of_total FROM with_average AS w CROSS JOIN total_count AS t WHERE t.total IS NOT NULL ORDER BY share_of_total DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
